decision.exact_command_or_message: for f in /c/KenshiTestRuns/inflight/*; do n=$(basename $f); s=$(cat /c/KenshiTestRuns/agents/$n.status 2>/dev/null); case $s in DONE*) rm -f $f;; esac; done
decision.why: A marker of a DONE agent keeps the Stop hook and waker guard counting finished work; lane markers have no status file, so the loop leaves them alone.

decision.exact_command_or_message: for n in imm26-4080-i4op imm26-4080-i4op2 imm26-4080-i4op3 imm26-4080-op2b imm26-4080-op2c imm26-4080-op2d imm26-4080-op2e imm26-5090-ctxop imm26-5090-ctxop2 imm26-5090-i3op imm26-5090-i4op imm26-compose-fix-batch2 imm26-compose-fix-batch2b imm26-install-nc-rest imm26-inv-travel imm26-inv-travel2 imm26-lanes-4080 imm26-lanes-5090 imm26-rowtools imm26-travel-investigate imm26-wpA4 imm26-wpB4; do s=$(cat /c/KenshiTestRuns/agents/$n.status 2>/dev/null); case $s in RUNNING*) touch /c/KenshiTestRuns/inflight/$n;; esac; done

decision.exact_command_or_message: For each name in the earlier rm-loop list (imm26-4080-i4op ... imm26-wpB4) that session-start -Brief lists as ORPHANED or NO SUCCESSOR, or whose status is STOPPED-CONTEXT or FAILED with no successor: an Agent named the next free number (check agents/status for existing names first; expected imm26-wpA5, imm26-wpB5, imm26-lanes-4080-2, imm26-lanes-5090-2, imm26-travel-investigate2), description starting with the [case:...] tag from its status file; brief = its agents/<name>.status plus its handoff file, same work dir, fresh start from the last checkpoint, reports to its status file; no SendMessage to the old agent
decision.why: The 15:50 handoff says these agents are dead, and a stopped agent with no successor must get a fresh respawn rather than a message.
